company.description: Dataform is a platform for analysts to manage SQL data workflows in cloud data warehouses such as Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift or Snowflake. With Dataform, analysts can own data management in the warehouse, turning transform raw data into reliable datasets ready for analysis.
